The real local files in examples.py are a simplified stand-in for a table's actual Parquet data files and Iceberg/Delta manifest format, disclosed in the script's own docstring and FACT-CHECK.md red-team #1. A fixed-width manifest entry exists so the measured byte reduction is exact, not an approximation of either format's real binary manifest layout.

The open/LIST overhead figure (a fixed cost per file touched) is a deterministic cost-model proxy for Iceberg's documented file-open cost and the AWS S3 Tables post's own measured 8.5x read-request difference, not a timed wall-clock measurement — consistent with this site's standing no-flaky-timing rule, per FACT-CHECK.md red-team #2.
